signal.rationale: The Letter of Award worth Rs 40.25 crore is 44.2% of TTM revenue of Rs 91.13 crore, with no execution period stated, and an LoA counts as a firm award. Orders of this size are rare in the packet: the Rs 41.35 crore January 2025 order was the company's largest to date, and the March 2025 GETCO letter of intent was similar, so this is not a routine monthly order. No disqualifier applies: TTM PAT is Rs 25.28 crore, TTM operating margin is 38.6%, and finance cost is negligible.
